bad_guidance.why: Product detail page selected as top core record for a habit-name form sheet; driven by the wrong 'ecommerce' product tag and touch.minimum_target coverage.
The Add Habit UI is a .sheet, not a drawer; the swiftui note recommends .inspector / NavigationSplitView.
'Sheets for secondary tasks' is already the case; says nothing about the keyboard.
Selected only to cover interaction.focus_visible, which was demanded because 'keyboard' was read as a hardware keyboard on a phone.

mobile-keyboard-ime (search #4, 0.388; 'return key Done, scroll focused field above the keyboard, keep the primary action reachable while the keyboard is open, never let the keyboard cover the submit button') is absent; mobile-safe-areas, mobile-thumb-reach and impl-reuse-before-new were candidates and dropped.

misses.what: 'keyboard' resolved to input=keyboard (hardware) on a mobile project, demanding interaction.keyboard_navigation / focus_visible / shortcuts; touch.ime_keyboard never entered the concept trace.
artifact_state=new and operations include 'create' because the token 'add' inside the proper noun 'Add Habit' matched the create rule; intent.existing=false for an existing sheet; preserve=[].
mode=create ('build/create request') for a 'make X work when Y' fix; expected polish/refactor/responsive.
touch.ime_keyboard and process.safe_modification never demanded although carriers exist (mobile-keyboard-ime, comp-form, impl-safe-modification).
mobile-safe-areas, mobile-thumb-reach, impl-reuse-before-new were candidates and dropped for PDP + drawer records.

layout-grid-catalog, card-poster-landscape (validator violation emitted, exit 3), density changed 4 -> medium, imagery/badges slots for a form sheet; cta-sticky-bar coincidentally right but reached via the ecommerce path.

product_hints ecommerce for a habit tracker; theme INFERRED with 0/0 hex evidence (Swift 0xRRGGBB not parsed); radius evidence from a single twin value; 'monospace usage' false; components UNKNOWN despite Components/*.swift.
